name: Grafana
compose:
services:
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:11.5.2
    environment:
      GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD}
      GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP: false
    ports:
      - '3000:3000'
    volumes:
      - grafana-data:/var/lib/grafana
volumes:
  grafana-data:
